reviews.comment: The cashmere drape and weight are truly peerless. The hand-finished lining demonstrates world-class tailoring.
Exquisite silk charmeuse. Feels weightless on the skin and the ivory sheen is understated and elegant.
A genuine masterpiece of Italian cordwaining. The alligator scales are perfectly symmetrical.
Stunning brilliance and fire. The white gold setting is crisp and secure. Truly an heirloom item.
Magnificent Carrara marble. It commands the center of our dining room table with quiet authority.
The softest cashmere blanket I have ever owned. Exceptional craftsmanship.
The micro-pavé diamonds catch the light subtly. Solid, weighty feel without being gaudy.
Flawless travel companion. The leather aroma and grain finish are sublime.
